edges.reason: msg.sender invokes the public transfer entry point.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
transferFrom calls ensure to whitelist the source before moving funds.
ensure falls back to condition when the source is not whitelisted.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf with raw -= and += instead of SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements allowance without SafeMath, allowing wrap-around underflow.
allowance is keyed and spent using the attacker-controlled msg.sender.
msg.sender calls approve to grant allowances.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure checks canSale[_from] to bypass the sale restriction.
ensure treats tradeAddress as a trusted sender.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the whitelisted Uniswap pair address.
pairFor result is stored in local _UNI inside ensure.
condition reads _minSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _saleNum as the per-address sale threshold.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to count previous sales.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a successful transfer.
delegate is reachable only when msg.sender equals owner.
delegate enforces require(msg.sender == owner) before delegating.
delegate executes an arbitrary low-level delegatecall supplied by the caller.
The delegatecall target regains control and can reenter contract state as owner.
init is callable only when msg.sender equals owner.
init depends on the single-owner check require(msg.sender == owner).
init overwrites _minSale using an unchecked token*(10**decimals) product.
init overwrites _maxSale using an unchecked maxToken*(10**decimals) product.
init overwrites _saleNum with the caller-supplied saleNum.
batchSend is callable only when msg.sender equals owner.
batchSend depends on the single-owner check require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend performs total = _value * _tos.length and balance updates without SafeMath.
batchSend directly subtracts from and adds to balanceOf inside the loop.
Batch total is stored in an unchecked local variable.
setTradeAddress is callable only when msg.sender equals owner.
setTradeAddress depends on the single-owner check require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
The constructor assigns owner and the whole supply to msg.sender.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
Constructor computes totalSupply from _supply.
Constructor mints the entire supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
transferFrom reaches the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic block.
The owner-controlled caller supplies the delegatecall target and payload.
Constructor scales the _supply parameter into totalSupply.
_value flows into the unchecked balance subtraction of transferFrom.
_value flows into the unchecked balance additions of batchSend.
The calldata parameter b is executed by the delegatecall.
The address parameter a is the delegatecall target.
